_doc: Data for scripts/animation/ladder-smoke.mjs: the focused smoke of each SGD-ladder MVP slice. Lanes edit THIS file, not the script.
exists  {paths[]}  every path exists in the checkout (a stale pin fails at once).
route   {path, expect[], cookie?}  one GET against --origin; the status must be in expect (cookie: send --cookie-file).

tests   {cwd, files[], optional?, env?}  node --test over the named files (cwd is relative to the repo root; a file entry may be an object {file, optional} or a basename glob such as test/animation-*stream*.test.js).
A required file that is missing is a FAIL before anything runs (a stale list fails at once); an optional entry that matches nothing is a loud SKIP (ladder-smoke --strict turns it into a FAIL).
A run that executes 0 tests is a FAIL (node --test over a bad path exits 0).

script  {cmd, args[], optional?, needs?[]}  a command that must exit 0. optional: a missing script file is a SKIP. needs: variables from the command line (origin, sha, cookie) the item cannot run without: SKIP when absent.
bundle  {dir | origin:true, features[], expect?}  the built (dist-dev) or served (--origin) web bundle declares the client features (bundle-probe.mjs); expect 'absent' proves a recovery.
copy    {dir | origin:true, absent[], present[]}  regular expressions that must NOT / must match some chunk of the bundle (request-box copy).

browser {cmd}  a browser check: printed always, run only with --browser when the local stack answers; otherwise a loud SKIP that is NOT a pass (Claude does not run browser checks; CI fast-e2e or the owner does).

gate2   {frozen[]}  reads the recorded Gate 2 result (sgd-qualify.mjs result-<sha7>-<stamp>.json via --gate2-result, a file or its folder): verdict PASS, 8 of the first 9 recounted, control not SGD, the tested sha is this checkout or an ancestor with no change since to a frozen path. Never creates a job. Absent: a loud SKIP that --strict fails. --gate2-pending (while Gate 2 is still running) reports the item as PENDING instead: the run ends "PENDING GATE 2 (not a release pass)" with exit 3, never 0, so it cannot stand in for the fast path's --smoke.

combined (owner decision 23): ONE release carries mvp2b + mvp3 + mvp4 + mvp5. A slice with includes[] is the union of those slices (ids prefixed mvp3:..., a tests file already run by an earlier included item is not run again) followed by its own items, so the old-client 409 path, the golden-fixture browser check and the Gate 2 result are always in it. Use: ladder-smoke.mjs combined --strict --sha <C4> --gate2-result <dir>; while Gate 2 runs, --gate2-pending instead (exit 3).

flags: the five MVP3 client features. golden: packages/web/src/animation3d/testdata/sgd-golden.json (AN-19; its artifact is under .artifact). An optional item whose file is not in the candidate is a loud SKIP; ladder-smoke --strict turns it into a FAIL (use --strict for the release smoke).

landsWith: required files that are not on main yet and the lane branch that brings them. The shipped-config test accepts a missing required file only if it is listed here, and fails a listed file that already exists (remove the entry when the lane has merged).
